result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but the restaurant cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel are vertically misaligned relative to each other, causing inconsistent card heights and uneven text baselines across the row.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card is offset vertically compared to 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccolo' — its image starts lower and its title/delivery-fee text sits lower than the neighboring cards, breaking row alignment.
issues.suggestion: Fix card heights so all cards in the carousel align to the same top and bottom edges, keeping images and text labels on a consistent baseline.

issues.description: The time-badge pills on the cards ('15–25 min', '20–30 min', '20–30 min') are positioned at slightly different vertical offsets on their respective images, contributing to the inconsistent look of the carousel.
issues.suggestion: Standardize image aspect ratios and badge placement across all restaurant card images.
